name: MARKED FOR JUSTICE
text: Once per turning point, for no CP: pick any enemy as your mark. Friendly Exaction Squad operatives shooting, fighting or retaliating against it have Punishing. Whenever the mark falls you may pick a new one for the rest of the turning point.

name: ATTACK PATTERN
text: Turning point 1 only, for no CP: the Leashmaster picks two different attack patterns for a friendly Cyber-mastiff, kept for the battle.

name: FIRST IN THE FIELD
text: Turning point 1 only, for no CP: a Revelatum wholly within your drop zone takes a free Reposition.

name: GUILT REVEALS ITSELF
text: This turning point, when a friendly Exaction Squad operative picks a valid target, an enemy within 4 inches of it cannot count as in cover for that choice (2 inches normally). It keeps its cover save unless within 2 inches.

name: INVIOLATE JURISDICTION
text: This turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly Exaction Squad operative within 2 inches of an objective marker or of an enemy, you may re-roll one defence die.

name: DISPENSE JUSTICE
text: This turning point, when a friendly Exaction Squad operative fights or retaliates, its melee weapons have Ceaseless if it has not moved more than its Move stat in the activation, or if it is counteracting.

name: TERMINAL DECREE
text: This turning point, when a friendly Exaction Squad operative shoots an enemy within 6 inches, and whenever a friendly Gunner shoots at any range, its ranged weapons have Balanced.

name: LONG ARM OF THE EMPEROR'S LAW
text: When a friendly Exaction Squad operative performs Shoot, a ranged weapon with Range x (not frag or krak grenades) it picks has Range 3 inches longer until the end of the action.

name: EXACT PUNISHMENT
text: After an enemy shoots or fights a friendly Exaction Squad operative within 6 inches of it that survives, that operative takes a free Shoot or Fight against that enemy only.

name: BRUTAL BACKUP
text: During a friendly Exaction Squad operative's activation, pick an enemy in its control range: another friendly Exaction Squad operative takes a free Fight against that enemy only.

name: EXECUTION ORDER
text: When an enemy performs a mission action other than Operate Hatch, or at the end of the Firefight phase against an enemy controlling an objective: the next time it is activated, a ready friendly Exaction Squad operative strikes it first.
